scope: Targeted public late-UI helper diagnostic only: fresh public fixture import, persistent receive copy, ETH/USDT buttons/navigation, whole-asset amounts and Send form. This is not the complete packaged recovery campaign.

steps.name: Wallet page always shows the complete receive address and working copy icon without visible provider-observed metadata or an asset dropdown
Real asset buttons select USDT and restore ETH, update the wallet tab and explain whole-asset amount units
Send uses Amount and explicit 1 = 1 ETH guidance, with no Scan local QR image control

notRun: live Bybit authentication, deposits, spot fills and withdrawals
Earlier onboarding/password errors, wrong-word confirmation, generated phrase recovery, DCR/settings/exchange cancellation, restart/profile/canary cases NOT_RUN in this targeted diagnostic
